source: AEMO Next_Day_Dispatch TOTALCLEARED minus the last Next_Day_PreDispatch run issued at least 0:25:00 before the block, normalized by the unit's AVAILABILITY
signal_semantics: positive delta is EV up; negative delta is EV down
trading_day: NEM time, 04:05 to 04:00, stamped at interval end
unit_selection: reports ENERGY_STORAGE, and offers at least 20.0 MW
